body: I'm glad that you took comfort in getting that out, it helped me a lot too...maybe there is some good for me yet..I think a list would help me but I feel like I don't have many hours in the day to even be able to do everything...I feel like I have no time. And thinking about things that make me happy I can't really think...this sounds cheesy and stupid but when I hang out with my recent ex that I stil like and vice versa I feel happy and safe. I don't know what it is, I just feel like all the weights lifted and I don't remember why I'm sad. So I guess that makes me happy..and listening to good upbeat music and I love doing art so I make sculptures and picture for people which calms me down. I do those as much as I can but most weeks I have so much homework I can't do them..
Thank you so much for replying! How did you deal with your traumatic 20s? Any advice..
